note: Old name -> new name for batch 2C (overlays and feedback). Identical names keep their symbol but change signature, see 'changes'. Library: package:charcoal_ui/next.dart.

symbols.showConsoleDialog: showCharcoalDialog (+ CharcoalDialog surface; actions are passed to CharcoalDialog.actions)

changes: Dialogs are Material DialogRoutes (CharcoalDialogRoute); the title and actions stay in place while the body scrolls, and the dialog lifts above the keyboard and respects the safe area.

Dialog, toast, tooltip and balloon colours, radii and spacing come from the CharcoalTheme pack; the old CharcoalTheme(data:) wrapper in overlay entries is replaced by InheritedTheme.capture, so overlays keep the ambient Theme.
Prebuilt dialogs take their button labels as parameters (English defaults); myopay passes its own Chinese labels. consoleErrorMessage (Dio unwrapping) is application code and stays in myopay.
Toast duration defaults to motion.toastVisible; consoleToast replaced the previous toast, showCharcoalToast stacks (dismiss the previous controller to replace).
CharcoalSnackBar thumbnails use the appended metric metrics.toast.thumbnailSize (64).
ConsoleSpinner/ConsoleLoading use Charcoal's expanding-circle spinner instead of CircularProgressIndicator.
showCharcoalFormDialog uses CharcoalTextField / CharcoalTextArea by default.
